## Description {#details}

<p>This pass calculates the liveness information for each basic block in a function and attaches the register live-out information to a patchpoint intrinsic if present.</p>


<p>This pass can be disabled via the -enable-patchpoint-liveness=false flag. The pass skips functions that don't have any patchpoint intrinsics. The information provided by this pass is optional and not required by the aformentioned intrinsic to function.</p>


<p>Definition at line 50 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/codegen/stackmaplivenessanalysis-cpp">StackMapLivenessAnalysis.cpp</a>.</p>
